notes.title: 📢 Legacy of Valor is coming to Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[p][b]We are thrilled to officially announce:[/b][/p][h1][b]The Kickstarter campaign will launch on Friday, October 10th, 2025 at 16:00 CET (4:00 PM GMT+2, Czech Republic time).[/b][/h1][p]
[/p][h2]⏰ Global Launch Times:[/h2][p]
[b]Prague / Berlin / Warsaw: 16:00 (CET/CEST, 24h)[/b][/p][p][b]London: 15:00 (BST, 24h)[/b][/p][p][b]New York (US Eastern): 10:00 AM (EST)[/b][/p][p][b]Chicago (US Central): 9:00 AM (CST)[/b][/p][p][b]Los Angeles (US Pacific): 7:00 AM (PST)[/b][/p][p][b]São Paulo (Brazil): 11:00 AM (BRT)[/b][/p][p][b]Dubai (UAE): 18:00 (6:00 PM GST, 24h)[/b][/p][p][b]Beijing / Shanghai (China): 22:00 (10:00 PM CST, 24h)[/b][/p][p][b]Tokyo (Japan): 23:00 (11:00 PM JST, 24h)[/b][/p][p][b]Sydney (Australia): 01:00 (1:00 AM AEST) - Saturday, October 11th[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Why being there on day one matters:
[/h2][h3]Follow our campaign page now - [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/legacyofvalorgame/legacy-of-valor-medieval-rpg-build-conquer-rule"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/legacyofvalorgame/legacy-of-valor-medieval-rpg-build-conquer-rule[/url] - and you’ll get notified the moment we go live.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]The first 24 hours are critical, the more support we gather at launch, the better our chances to trigger the Kickstarter algorithm and reach “Projects We Love.”[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Share the news with friends and communities - help us spread the word worldwide.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]⚔️ Partnership with Drakkaria/Wulflund & the Unique Sword[/h3][p][b]We are proud to announce a new partnership with Drakkaria.cz, a Czech manufacturer of historical replicas.[/b][/p][p][b]At the public event on October 5th, 2025 at Brandýs Castle, we will unveil our custom made one and a half hand sword created exclusively for Legacy of Valor.[/b]
[/p][p][b][u]👉 This sword will be part of a limited reward tier on Kickstarter[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][h2]📅 Save these two important dates:
[/h2][h3][b]October 5th, 2025 (09:30-16:00 CET)- Public event at Brandýs nad Labem Castle (medieval program, music, playable prototype, sword unveiling).
[/b][/h3][h3][b]October 10th, 2025 at 16:00 CET (4:00 PM GMT+2) - Kickstarter campaign launch.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you very much for your support! ❤️[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][b]-Filip[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Legacy of Valor at Gamescom!
notes.notes: [p]I’m excited to share that [b][i]Legacy of Valor[/i][/b] was showcased at Gamescom 2025 in the B2B business area! The project and trailer were officially presented on August 21st after 2 PM at the CZECHIA booth 🇨🇿[/p][p]The trailer was also playing on the screen throughout the event, giving visitors a continuous look at the game.[/p][p]I also had several meetings with potential publishers and investors and the interest was incredible! There are already some very promising opportunities in motion, so there’s a lot to look forward to. 🙌[/p][p][b]The trailer will be released publicly very soon, and I can’t wait to hear what you think once it’s out.[/b][/p][p]💙 Thank you all for your amazing support, it truly makes a difference![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482002/b92817731e350a9fb27973e1b98c5ea5c00b3651.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 Playtest Temporarily Paused - and a Huge Thank You to All of You! 🛡️
notes.notes: [p]🛠 Playtest Temporarily Paused - and a Huge Thank You to All of You! 🛡️ [/p][p] [/p][p]Today marks the end of the first playtest of Legacy of Valor - and I want to sincerely thank you from the bottom of my heart. [/p][p]Every one of you who took the time to test the game, report bugs, share feedback, or simply send a kind word of support… it all means the world to me. 🙏 [/p][p] [/p][p]📊 Thanks to this playtest, I managed to: [/p][p]fix over 120 bugs and issues, [/p][p]add 73 new features, systems, improvements, and pieces of content. [/p][p] [/p][p]Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and I take it all to heart. I'm already working on the next round of playtesting, which as promised will launch soon and be even better. [/p][p] [/p][p]💌 You don’t need to do anything again, your application will automatically carry over to the next round, and you’ll have priority over new applicants. [/p][p] [/p][p]✨ And honestly, I never expected such an overwhelming wave of interest and support. [/p][p]Nearly 10,000 people signed up for the playtest, whether through the Google form or the Steam page button. [/p][p]I’m absolutely blown away and incredibly grateful for each and every one of you. ❤️ [/p][p] [/p][p]And most importantly - our journey is only just beginning. [/p][p]Thank you for choosing to walk this path with me and for helping to build the world of Legacy of Valor together. [/p][p] [/p][p]Filip[/p]
